properties.text:
In this game, you control both knights [color=#ffff00]simultaneously[/color]. Your goal is to guide each knight to their respective [color=#ffff00]flag[/color]. Along the way, you will encounter deadly obstacles such as spikes, saws, cannons, and pools of lava. You will also need to toggle levers that move elevators to finish the game.

[color=#ffff00]\[Left][/color]/[color=#ffff00]\[Right][/color]: Move left and right
[color=#ffff00]\[Up][/color]: Jump
[color=#ffff00]\[Down][/color]: Drop from platform

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] to start...
